title: Cascade limit buys on ES/NQ (transfer of the crypto 'cascade limit' sleeve)
rule: each trade date: limit level L = prior trade-date close x (1 - k x sd20), sd20 = 20-day sd of daily close-to-close returns (lagged); filled if any hourly low of the trade date is <= L x (1 - 1 tick) (trade-through), at price L; exit at the trade-date close (X0) or the next trade-date close (X1); one fill per day; 0.5 per index; cost_frac per side (2 sides)
judgement: EQR book + entrant; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.231
